title: Where the browser runs
description: A page served by a Worker at cyberspace-explorer.com that runs entirely in the reader's browser and reads public repositories straight from their hosts; signed in, it reads GitHub through the Worker.

nodes.name: Reader's browser
nodes.description: Any current browser, on a laptop or a desktop monitor.

nodes.name: Cyberspace explorer
nodes.description: The page and its script, running in the browser tab.

nodes.name: Browser storage
nodes.description: sessionStorage and localStorage, holding the reader's tokens under cyberspace-explorer.tokens.

nodes.name: cyberspace-explorer.com
nodes.description: A Cloudflare Worker that serves the page at / and, when configured, the optional GitHub sign-in.

nodes.name: jsDelivr
nodes.description: Serves dagre and the Barlow typefaces.

nodes.name: GitHub API
nodes.description: api.github.com: the default branch, the recursive tree, and files when a token is in use.

nodes.name: raw.githubusercontent.com
nodes.description: Files of a GitHub repository read without a token.
nodes.condition: the address is on github.com and no token covers it

nodes.name: GitLab API
nodes.description: /api/v4 on gitlab.com or a self-hosted GitLab that allows the page's origin.
nodes.condition: the address is not on github.com

artifacts.name: index.html
artifacts.description: The whole page: markup, styles, script and icons. Served by the Worker in worker/.

relationships.description: Keeps the storage for the page's origin.
Loads the typefaces and the layout library.
Lists the repository; with a token, reads files too.
Lists the project and reads each .dev file.
Reads and writes the reader's tokens.
